name: ask-better
description: Prompt coach based on ESR's "How To Ask Questions The Smart Way": after each reply, one line on how your request could be clearer, or nothing if it already is.

interface.shortDescription: Coaches you to ask clearer questions
interface.longDescription: After each reply, adds at most one line on what your request was missing (goal, raw error, expected vs actual, scope) with a better phrasing. Silent when the request is already clear.
defaultPrompt: Review my last request with ask-better.
How could I ask this more clearly?
